deletion_scope: runs/<RUN>/scratch only (exact SHA allowlist after audit+commit; the stores of an interrupted image that cannot be verified on resume); existing stores never deleted
expected_ssd_write_note: per image: FullLoad store + IMPRESS store (written, then rewritten in the reordered layout) + Ours store; the devgate phase has no FullLoad store; sizes from the 2026-11-17 main run's disk_usage.json of the same image (the Ours store has the size of that run's packed store); raw rows and evidence not included
policy: FRESH_IMAGE_STREAMING (image-major): one live image; stores built from the arms' own T1 of the image's first dialogue -> served -> audited -> committed -> run-local scratch deleted by exact SHA256 allowlist
